notes: Catalog of useful public entry points. Access is descriptive, not a promise of a working integration. Verification dates apply to the exact entries, not the entire catalog; verify the exact page before relying on a claim.

sources.name: Steam game pages and search
sources.purpose: Find close competitors, user tags, positioning, release dates, advertised scope, regional pricing and visible review response. Include recent or weak comparables as well as hits.
sources.access: Public web. Three individual game pages were verified on 2026-09-06; search entry point itself was not tested. Region, language, age gates and cache may affect results.
sources.query_recipe: Search a mechanic plus player promise; inspect each game's canonical page. Record currency, filters, access date and whether the source was a cached web result.

sources.name: Steam charts
sources.purpose: Broad current visibility and activity signals; repeated comparable observations may inform timing, but chart presence alone is not opportunity validation.
sources.access: Public entry point; not tested in this pilot. Charts may be dynamic or regional.

sources.name: Steamworks user reviews documentation
sources.purpose: Understand review eligibility, displayed scores and feedback limitations before comparing review evidence.
sources.access: Public official documentation; opened successfully on 2026-09-06.

sources.name: Steamworks Coming Soon documentation
sources.purpose: Check release visibility requirements and audience-building lead time separately from development time.
sources.access: Public official documentation; opened successfully on 2026-09-06. Recheck before scheduling a launch.

sources.name: Steamworks Next Fest documentation
sources.purpose: Explore demo discovery opportunities and verify current event dates and eligibility.
sources.access: Public official documentation entry point; not tested in this pilot. Event dates and eligibility are not assumed.

sources.name: itch.io games
sources.purpose: Browse small experimental games by tag; examine comparable hooks, available demos and visible feedback beyond Steam incumbents.
sources.access: Public browsing entry point; not tested in this pilot. Rankings are platform-specific; downloads, revenue and private analytics are not presumed available.

sources.name: itch.io jams
sources.purpose: Find constrained mechanics, recent prototypes and jam feedback. A jam ranking is not a commercial demand measurement.
sources.access: Public entry point; not tested in this pilot. Individual entries or voting pages may have access limits.

sources.name: Google Trends
sources.purpose: Compare repeated search-interest observations for themes or mechanics with explicit period and geography; distinguish a franchise/news spike from a durable player need.
sources.access: Public interactive interface; not tested in this pilot. JavaScript or rate limits may prevent extraction. Search coverage is secondary evidence and must be labeled.

sources.name: Exploding Topics public blog
sources.purpose: Find theme leads for further game-specific validation; broad consumer interest is not evidence of game purchases.
sources.access: Public blog entry point; not tested in this pilot. Some data may be paid or inaccessible; do not imply access to paid metrics.

sources.name: Reddit player communities
sources.purpose: Look for specific player requests, frustrations and vocabulary in relevant genre communities. Treat anecdotes as anecdotes and search for disagreement.
sources.access: Public search/browser access where available; not tested in this pilot. No account access or permission to post is implied.
sources.query_recipe: Use scoped web searches such as site:reddit.com/r/CozyGamers <mechanic> or site:reddit.com/r/IndieGaming <game> with an explicit date range. Record the exact post URL, not the search page.

sources.name: YouTube gameplay and developer channels
sources.purpose: Inspect first-minute clarity, visible play friction and creator-friendly moments; compare channels and dates before interpreting attention.
sources.access: Public entry point; not tested in this pilot. Views are neither players nor purchases. A title or thumbnail alone cannot substantiate what happens in a video.

sources.name: Max Inferno press kit
sources.purpose: Primary developer description of A Little to the Left: interaction, content and presentation expectations for a tactile puzzle comparable.
sources.access: Public developer page; opened successfully on 2026-09-06. Some copy differs internally on puzzle counts; avoid treating the page as a current inventory.

sources.name: Epic editor Python documentation
sources.purpose: Verify editor automation, unattended scripting and content-production workflows against the installed engine version.
sources.access: Official page opened on 2026-09-07. A separate local UE 5.8.2 editor scripting probe executed successfully; this does not establish an asset import or game build.

sources.name: Blender licensing and output rights
sources.purpose: Distinguish artwork/output rights from Blender and add-on code licensing before using original modeling in a game.
sources.access: Official page inspected on 2026-09-07. Blender was not executed locally during this research; several current English manual fetches failed.

sources.name: Quaternius Modular Sci-Fi Megakit
sources.purpose: Compare a coherent editable sci-fi environment route, exact free/paid contents, formats and CC0 rights.
sources.access: Creator page inspected on 2026-09-07. No download or import. The complete Source offering's Unreal integration must not be attributed to the partial free offering.

sources.name: Fab Standard License
sources.purpose: Check modification, commercial use, collaborator sharing and source redistribution limits for the exact acquired asset.
sources.access: Official public license page inspected on 2026-09-07. Acquisition-specific terms, other license types and entitlements still need verification before use.

sources.name: Poly Haven asset license
sources.purpose: Verify CC0 terms for material, lighting and model inputs, separately from website images and branding.
sources.access: Official page inspected on 2026-09-07. No assets downloaded or integrated.

sources.name: Product Hunt
sources.purpose: Optional early theme or interaction leads inherited from the Appdrip approach. Maker interest is weak evidence of a game-buying audience and requires game-specific checks.
sources.access: Public entry point; not tested in this pilot. Dynamic pages or account restrictions may limit access.
